Title: Community Picnic

Description:
Come along for a relaxed community picnic at East Point Reserve!

Date: Monday 22 December 2025  
Time: 1:00 pm – 5:00 pm  
Location: Main grass area by the big playground, near the carpark, East Point Reserve, Darwin

This is a casual neighbourhood get‑together hosted by Alex Rodriguez – friends, neighbours, and plus‑ones are all welcome. Kids are definitely welcome too.

What to bring:
- Picnic rug or camp chairs  
- Hat, sunscreen, reusable water bottle  
- A plate of food to share (snacks, salads, or something simple you like)

Food & drinks:
- I’ll bring an esky with some soft drinks and ice.  
- Plan is to do a basic sausage sizzle using the BBQs there (if available).

Other details:
- Casual, family‑friendly vibe – feel free to bring outdoor games (frisbee, ball, cricket set, cards, etc.).  
- The area is grass and mostly flat, but it’s not a formal accessible venue.

Weather plan:
Darwin weather can be wild in December.  
If thunderstorms or really extreme heat are likely on the day, we’ll postpone to a nearby date for everyone’s safety and comfort. Any changes will be shared via Facebook, WhatsApp, and email.

RSVP:
Please let me know roughly how many people you’re bringing so we can plan food and space.

Short version for WhatsApp

Community picnic at East Point Reserve 🌳  
Mon 22 Dec 2025, 1–5 pm  
Main grass area by the big playground (near carpark)

Casual neighbourhood hangout – friends/neighbours + kids welcome.  
Bring: picnic rug/chairs, hat, sunscreen, water bottle + a plate of food to share.  
I’ll bring soft drinks + ice and do a basic sausage sizzle (if BBQs are free).

If storms or really nasty heat are forecast, we’ll postpone to a nearby date and update here / by message.

Organizer checklist (for you)

Before the day:
- Confirm BBQs at East Point Reserve and what you need (tools, cleaning gear).  
- Post the Facebook event, share link in WhatsApp, send the email.  
- Ask 1–2 people to bring extra salads/snacks, a couple of spare rugs/chairs, and some games.  
- Shopping list: sausages, bread, onions, sauces, oil, soft drinks, ice, garbage bags, paper towels/wipes, BBQ tongs and tools, serving utensils, hand sanitiser.  
- A couple of days before: check the forecast and, if it looks bad, warn people there’s a chance of postponement.

On the day:
- Arrive ~12:15–12:30 pm to grab the grass spot near the big playground and carpark, and claim a BBQ.  
- Set up: esky, shared-food spot/table, rubbish bags.  
- Do a quick last forecast check late morning; if it looks unsafe (storms/extreme heat), post/send a postponement message.

If you want, I can tweak the wording to be more formal or more casual, or tailor a super‑short email version for specific people.</action>
